paper_metadata.title: Synergistic effects of Si addition and deformation-induced martensitic transformation on the cryogenic mechanical behavior of FeCoCrNiV high-entropy alloy

evidence.quote: Mechanical behavior of the Fe47Co30Cr10Ni5V8-xSix (x = 0, 3, 4, and 6) high-entropy alloys (HEAs) at the cryogenic temperature of 77 K was systematically investigated, with a particular focus on the importance of α′-martensite strength.
